page_title: Convo | The #1 Real-Time AI Sales Assistant & Coach

sources.entry: Convo - AI meeting assistant that listens in real time, helps you respond smarter on calls, and automates your follow up workflow.

summary.name: Convo
summary.one_liner: Convo is a real-time AI sales assistant that listens to live sales and customer success calls, suggests responses to objections, and drafts follow-ups and CRM updates.
use_cases: get live objection responses during a sales call
review and coach rep performance from calls
prepare for a renewal or customer call
draft follow-up emails after customer calls
track open commitments and missing stakeholders on deals
onboard new sales reps faster with approved company answers
summary.what_it_does: Convo listens to live calls and surfaces suggested replies on the user's screen, visible only to the rep, when objections or buying signals come up. Its Live Assistant analyses the conversation every few seconds and flags things like budget, timing, decision makers and missing answers, and a user can press Command+Enter for a response on demand. It can pull answers from company documents and past calls. After calls it drafts follow-ups and prepares notes and tasks for the CRM, and it provides conversation intelligence, deal risk views and manager coaching moments. The page also describes an MCP connection that lets Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor query meeting memory.
notable: Live on-screen suggestions visible only to the rep, not to other call participants
Pulls answers from the team's own documents, pricing, and past calls
Works with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor via MCP for meeting memory
Syncs notes and tasks to CRM after calls
caveats: Paid product; the page lists pricing from $22.49/month without detailing tiers
Desktop support stated only for Mac and Windows
Marketing-heavy page; performance claims such as higher win rates are not independently verified here
